message.content: {"caption":"A branching network of agents, colored by hallucination-solving score and outlined by basic functionality.","description":"The target is a network diagram made of many small circular nodes arranged in branching levels. Each node contains a tiny numerical agent ID; most IDs are too small to read reliably. The page identifies node 0 as the initial agent, shown at the top. Thin gray lines and a few prominent dark lines connect parent agents to offspring; no arrowheads or edge labels are visible, and the parent-to-child direction follows the branching layout. Node fill color encodes “Solve Halluc Score” on the vertical scale at right, from dark blue near 0 through green to yellow near 2, with ticks at 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, and 2. Most nodes are dark blue/teal or green, with a small number of brighter yellow-green nodes. Red and green node outlines distinguish the two legend categories: “3 tasks (no basic functionality)” and “3 tasks (with basic functionality),” respectively. A star marks the “Final best agent” on a node in the upper-left portion of the network. The network spreads from the top node into several broad branches, with dense rows of descendants and smaller sub-branches below.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
